The Opportunity:

CACI/Space’s Radar and Sensor Technologies group is seeking a senior systems engineer to support one of our primary programs working with the US Government to understand and define requirements for our software staff. In this position, you will be at the forefront of developing the systems that keep our nation safe and work in space emerging technology. This position will work with our team on adapting our architecture to the program requirements, creating a testing approach, and interacting across our program teams to ensure clear understanding during the software development cycle.
